### If a number looks wrong

This matters more than a crash. Please include:

- the value the app showed
- the value you believe is correct, and where you checked it
- the line from the rule trace or the citation, if there is one

The as-reported table on the Overview tab shows which filing concept a figure came from — that's usually the fastest way to see where a number went wrong.
